# Pull request

## Help & Resolution

If this PR touches `web/src/pages/help/**`, `backend/core/help_codes.py`, or Help copy in `docs/help/`, follow [docs/help/CONTRIBUTING.md](../docs/help/CONTRIBUTING.md):

- [ ] 6-check on any new/changed intent
- [ ] UI labels as `**t:dot.key**` and listed in `citedKeys`
- [ ] `python manage.py dump_help_codes` if codes changed
- [ ] Help reviewer requested (CODEOWNERS)
